environment: Kvant, pinned CI image (CMake 4.4.4, Qt 6.12, PipeWire 1.6.9), docker --network none, build directory /tmp/repro, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1778112000
method: Two clean builds (rm -rf, configure with the desktop preset, build), each archived with the script
cpack_comparison: CPack 4.4 with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH also gave identical archives in one account, but it records the build account's owner names, so archives from different accounts differ; the script records none.

gates.reproducible-archive CTest: two archives of one build byte-identical; entries sorted, 0/0 without names, dated SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH; unset SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH refused

limits: Same toolchain image and build directory; a different compiler or path can change the binaries. The revision recorded inside the container build was 'unknown' because the container cannot read the worktree's git metadata; CI passes CI_SOURCE_SHA. License notices for fl-live itself still wait on #84.
